enquiryPrivacyBody: When direct submission is available, Cloudflare Turnstile checks for automated abuse and Cloudflare D1 stores your contact email, page URL, market, goal, optional notes, language and acknowledgement version. We use these details to assess and reply to your enquiry. Enquiry records and pending internal notifications become eligible for deletion after 90 days and are cleared by a daily task. Briefly retained, keyed hashes of network addresses limit abuse; the form does not store raw IP addresses. Email or WhatsApp replies use their respective providers. You can request correction or deletion by contacting us.
